end.summary:
- Discussed placing fractions on a number line divided into equal gaps.
- Riya identified the first mark after 0 as 1/5 and the second mark as 2/5.
- Riya identified 11/10 as greater than 1.
- Riya concluded 2/5 is less than 1/2 because it is left of the midpoint.
- Teach-back was not passed; geometry preference interrupted the fraction practice.
end.parentNote: Riya practised reading fifths on a number line and comparing 2/5 with 1/2. They used the method of counting equal gaps and locating a fraction relative to the midpoint. They also mixed up the lesson focus by shifting to triangles, and this was not fully corrected before the lesson ended. At home, draw a 0-to-1 number line with five equal gaps and ask them to label each mark.
